name.en: Fundamentals

name.en: Classic networks

name.en: Course notes

name.zh: 上采样与转置卷积超详细入门：插值、尺寸公式、棋盘格与 U-Net 解码器
name.en: Upsampling and Transposed Convolution in Depth: Interpolation, Output Size, Checkerboards and U-Net Decoders

label.zh: 上采样与转置卷积超详细入门
label.en: Upsampling and Transposed Convolution in Depth

description.zh: 从像素网格手算最近邻与双线性插值，拆解转置卷积的散射相加、完整输出尺寸公式和 output_padding，图解棋盘格伪影，并给出 U-Net 解码器的选型与尺寸排错方法。
description.en: Calculate nearest-neighbour and bilinear interpolation on pixel grids, understand scatter-add transposed convolution, the complete output-size formula and output_padding, see why checkerboard artifacts occur, and debug U-Net decoder shapes.

name.zh: BatchNorm 超详细入门：手算公式、训练与推理差异，以及 BN/LN/IN/GN 怎么选
name.en: BatchNorm Explained in Depth: Manual Calculation, Train vs. Eval, and Choosing BN/LN/IN/GN

description.zh: 从四个数字手算 BatchNorm，图解 NCHW 上的统计范围、gamma/beta、running mean/var、train/eval 模式，并比较 LayerNorm、InstanceNorm 与 GroupNorm，解释小 batch 和医学影像中的选择。
description.en: Calculate BatchNorm from four numbers, see exactly which NCHW elements are normalised together, understand gamma/beta, running mean/variance and train/eval behaviour, and compare BatchNorm, LayerNorm, InstanceNorm and GroupNorm for small-batch medical imaging.

name.zh: ResNet 残差网络超详细入门：从退化问题到 BasicBlock 与 Bottleneck
name.en: ResNet Explained in Depth: From the Degradation Problem to BasicBlock and Bottleneck

label.zh: ResNet 残差网络超详细入门

description.zh: 从零理解 ResNet：为什么网络加深后训练误差反而升高，残差 F(x)+x 如何让恒等映射和梯度传播变容易，以及 BasicBlock、Bottleneck、投影捷径与 ResNet-18/50 的结构差异。
description.en: A beginner-friendly guide to ResNet: why training error can rise when a plain network gets deeper, how F(x)+x makes identity mappings and gradient flow easier, and how BasicBlock, Bottleneck and projection shortcuts differ in ResNet-18 and ResNet-50.

name.zh: Dice、IoU、HD95 医学图像分割评价指标详解：公式、代码与解读误区
name.en: Dice, IoU and HD95: Medical Segmentation Metrics Explained with Formulas and Code

label.zh: Dice、IoU、HD95 医学图像分割评价指标详解

description.zh: Dice、IoU、精确率、召回率与 HD95 分别衡量什么，如何用 Python 计算，以及体素间距、空预测、2D 与 3D 平均这些最容易出错的细节。
description.en: What Dice, IoU, precision, recall and HD95 each measure, how to compute them in Python, and the details that go wrong: voxel spacing, empty predictions, 2D vs 3D averaging.

name.zh: Dice Loss 公式、代码与常见错误：医学图像分割损失函数详解
name.en: Dice Loss: Formula, Code and Common Mistakes in Medical Image Segmentation

label.zh: Dice Loss 公式、代码与常见错误

description.zh: Dice Loss 的公式推导、PyTorch 实现，以及 5 个最常见的错误：先阈值再求损失、batch 级与样本级混用、空标注除零、多分类含背景。
description.en: The Dice Loss formula, a PyTorch implementation, and five common mistakes: thresholding before the loss, batch-level vs sample-level, empty masks, and counting background.

name.zh: U-Net 结构详解：编码器、跳跃连接与解码器如何做医学图像分割
name.en: U-Net Explained: Encoder, Skip Connections and Decoder for Medical Image Segmentation

description.zh: U-Net 为什么是医学图像分割的起点：编码器压缩语义、解码器恢复分辨率，跳跃连接把边界细节送回来，以及 3D U-Net 与 nnU-Net 的演化。
description.en: Why U-Net is where medical segmentation starts: the encoder compresses meaning, the decoder restores resolution, skip connections bring boundary detail back — plus 3D U-Net and nnU-Net.

name.zh: GFLOPs 怎么计算？卷积层 FLOPs 公式及其与参数量的区别
name.en: How to Calculate GFLOPs: Convolution FLOPs Formula vs. Parameter Count

description.zh: GFLOPs 到底在数什么：卷积层浮点运算量的推导，以及它和参数量为什么不是一回事。
description.en: Where the number comes from, and why it is not the same thing as parameter count.

name.zh: 深度学习模型参数量怎么计算？卷积层与全连接层公式详解
name.en: How to Calculate Deep Learning Model Parameters: Convolutional and Fully Connected Layer Formulas

label.zh: 深度学习模型参数量怎么计算？
label.en: How to Calculate Deep Learning Model Parameters

description.zh: 逐层拆解参数量的计算方式，并解释卷积的参数共享为什么让它比全连接层轻得多。
description.en: Counting weights per layer, and why convolution's weight sharing keeps it so much lighter than a dense layer.

name.zh: SENet 通道注意力详解：Squeeze-and-Excitation 原理与计算过程
name.en: SENet Channel Attention Explained: Squeeze-and-Excitation Principles and Computation

description.zh: Squeeze-and-Excitation：用全局平均池化加两层全连接，为每个通道学出一个重要性权重。
description.en: Squeeze to a vector, excite through two dense layers, then rescale every channel. A small block that keeps showing up everywhere.

name.zh: DenseNet 网络详解：密集连接、Growth Rate 与参数效率
name.en: DenseNet Explained: Dense Connections, Growth Rate, and Parameter Efficiency

description.zh: 密集连接为什么优于加法融合：拼接保留特征的独立性，Growth Rate 则是可控的复杂度节流阀。
description.en: Addition mixes features irreversibly; concatenation keeps every earlier feature available. That one difference explains most of the architecture.

name.zh: 医学影像深度学习模型全景：CNN、U-Net、Transformer 与基础模型
name.en: Deep Learning Models for Medical Imaging: CNNs, U-Net, Transformers, and Foundation Models

label.zh: 医学影像深度学习模型全景
label.en: Deep Learning Models for Medical Imaging

description.zh: 从骨干网络到分割、检测、生成与基础模型——一张医学影像深度学习的全景地图与发展时间线。
description.en: Backbones, segmentation, detection, generative models and foundation models — plus the timeline that connects them.

name.zh: MM-UNet MACM 模块详解：多尺度各向异性卷积如何提取 3D 特征
name.en: MM-UNet MACM Explained: Multi-Scale Anisotropic Convolutions for 3D Features

description.zh: 用四个尺度的各向异性卷积分支，同时理解切片内结构与切片间连续性，并控制大卷积核的成本。
description.en: Splitting k×k×k into orthogonal branches cuts roughly 84% of the parameters and fits MR's uneven slice spacing.

name.zh: MM-UNet GCM 模块详解：Mamba 如何建模 3D MRI 全局上下文
name.en: MM-UNet GCM Explained: Modeling Global Context in 3D MRI with Mamba

description.zh: 把 3D 特征体展开为序列，在保留卷积局部能力的同时，用 Mamba 以线性复杂度建模长距离联系。
description.en: Flatten the volume into a sequence and get long-range dependency at linear cost instead of quadratic.

name.zh: MM-UNet AFFM 模块详解：自适应特征融合如何抑制背景噪声
name.en: MM-UNet AFFM Explained: Adaptive Feature Fusion for Suppressing Background Noise

description.zh: 自适应特征融合模块用通道注意力筛选低层细节，再与已经对齐的高层语义特征相加。
description.en: A learned weight per channel, so detail gets through without dragging the background noise along with it.

name.zh: MM-UNet 论文详解：3D MRI 分割架构与 AFFM、GCM、MACM 模块
name.en: MM-UNet Explained: 3D MRI Segmentation with AFFM, GCM, and MACM

description.zh: MM-UNet 的三个创新点：AFFM 如何过滤噪声、GCM 如何看见全局、MACM 如何适应各向异性分辨率。
description.en: Three modules answering three problems — noisy feature fusion, missing global context, and anisotropic resolution.

name.zh: MM-UNet 3D Res2Net 编码器详解：2D 权重扩展与多尺度特征提取
name.en: MM-UNet 3D Res2Net Encoder: Expanding 2D Weights for Multi-Scale Feature Extraction

description.zh: 编码器细节：为什么选 Res2Net、2D 权重怎样改造成 3D，以及通道数增长背后的取舍。
description.en: How 2D pretrained weights become a 3D encoder, and why channel count grows as spatial resolution falls.

name.zh: 前列腺 MRI 分割为什么难？CNN、Transformer 与 MM-UNet 对比
name.en: Why Is Prostate MRI Segmentation Difficult? CNN, Transformer, and MM-UNet Compared

label.zh: 前列腺 MRI 分割为什么难？
label.en: Why Is Prostate MRI Segmentation Difficult?

description.zh: 前列腺 MRI 分割的研究脉络：CNN 的局部视野、Transformer 的平方复杂度，以及中间那个尚未解决的问题。
description.en: CNNs see too little, Transformers cost too much. The gap between them is where the research question lives.

name.zh: 图像分割方法对比：Otsu 阈值、Sobel/Canny 边缘检测与机器学习
name.en: Image Segmentation Methods Compared: Otsu Thresholding, Sobel/Canny Edges, and Machine Learning

description.zh: 阈值分割、边缘检测与机器学习三类方法的原理、代价与适用场景对比。
description.en: Three ways to pull structure out of an image, what each one assumes, and what each one costs.

name.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）基础详解：Token、Transformer、RLHF 与 RAG
name.en: Large Language Model Foundations: Tokens, Transformers, RLHF, and RAG

description.zh: 分词、嵌入、注意力、Transformer 块、预训练与规模、指令微调、RLHF、解码、KV 缓存、提示词、LoRA、RAG 与评测。
description.en: Tokenisation, embeddings, attention, the Transformer block, pre-training and scaling, instruction tuning, RLHF, decoding, the KV cache, prompting, LoRA, RAG and evaluation.

name.zh: CS231n 课程笔记：线性分类、反向传播与卷积神经网络
name.en: CS231n Course Notes: Linear Classification, Backpropagation, and Convolutional Neural Networks

description.zh: 线性分类器、损失、优化器、反向传播、初始化、批归一化、卷积、架构演进、迁移学习，以及网络到底学到了什么。
description.en: Linear classifiers, losses, optimisers, backpropagation, initialisation, batch norm, convolution, architecture history, transfer learning and what the network actually learned.

name.zh: 吴恩达机器学习专项课程笔记：回归、分类与神经网络知识地图
name.en: Andrew Ng Machine Learning Specialization Notes: Regression, Classification, and Neural Networks

label.zh: 吴恩达机器学习专项课程笔记
label.en: Andrew Ng Machine Learning Specialization Notes

description.zh: 回归、分类、神经网络、模型评估、决策树、聚类、异常检测、推荐系统、PCA 与强化学习——把整个专项课画成一张彼此相连的地图。
description.en: Regression, classification, neural networks, evaluation, decision trees, clustering, anomaly detection, recommenders, PCA and reinforcement learning — the whole specialization as one connected map.
